company.name: Lumachain
company.shortDescription: Lumachain is a supply chain platform designed for tracking the origin, condition, and location of items in the food supply chain.
company.description: Lumachain brings transparency to global supply chains, benefitting producers, enterprises, and consumers. Lumachain's platform tracks and traces the origin, location, and condition of individual items in a supply chain, in real-time, from farm to fork. This incentivizes farmers and manufacturers to create high-quality products. It allows enterprises to reduce waste, increase efficiency, and grow revenues and margins. It also allows consumers to know the condition and quality of what they buy, and that it has been ethically and sustainably sourced.
